connector.name: Sociavault MCP
connector.registryDescription: Scrape social data from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and ad libraries.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sociavault-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the olamide-olaniyan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SOCIAVAULT_API_KEY
env.description: Your SociaVault API key (format sk_live_...). Get one at https://sociavault.com/dashboard

env.name: SOCIAVAULT_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional override for the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.sociavault.com
